name: Arrestor Spoolers
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D fantasy strategy game animated sprite source. True transparent RGBA background. Exactly four full-body poses of ONE original upgraded Brasshollow creature in a perfectly regular 2x2 grid with equal square cells, wide clear transparent gutters. Painterly richly textured fantasy unit art, weathered brass and soot-black iron, warm directional light. Right-facing three-quarter camera; same identity, design, equipment, proportions and scale in all four cells. Full body and all weapons visible with generous 8% margin EACH cell. Same planted feet/paws positions in every cell. Four genuinely articulated idle keyframes reading row-major, visibly different joint and equipment angles; no static duplicate cutouts. No text, caption, watermark, gridlines, checkerboard, environment, scenery, floor or platform.  CRITICAL LAYOUT: make sheet square 1536x1536. Each of 4 cells is768x768. Draw characters substantially SMALLER within cells: subject occupies at most 70% of cell height and width, leave a full100px EMPTY margin on ALL sides of each subject. Nothing may touch outer image boundary or central seams.Creature Arrestor Spoolers. Stocky industrial cable worker with enormous brass shoulder reel, weighted copper arrestor loop in right gloved hand, square cold-quench canister on waist, work apron, blue-black pressure mask and broad armored boots. Huge reel above left shoulder entirely visible WITH LOTS OF SPACE ABOVE. Left hand on reel crank. Idle: 1 weighted loop hangs low beside thigh; 2 right elbow flexes lifting weighted loop to waist; 3 left hand turns crank and right arm bends loop up to chest; 4 loop lowers halfway and crank hand relaxes. All forearm/loop positions different. ONE identical cable loop and identical machinery in all four frames. Do not let spool touch top of cell! Reduce whole figure until entire reel fits with100px space above and under boots.
